rfam.description: Hepatitis A virus internal ribosome entry site (IRES)
rfam.comment: This family represents the internal ribosome entry site (IRES) of the the Hepatitis A virus. IRES elements allow cap and end-independent translation of mRNA in the host cell. The IRES achieves this by mediating the internal initiation of translation by recruiting a ribosomal 43S pre-initiation complex directly to the initiation codon and eliminates the requirement for eIF4F [2].
